name: georgeharker
description: Personal Claude Code plugins wrapping ruff, python-lsp-server (with pylsp-mypy), and shuck — LSP entries plus PostToolUse hooks.

plugins.name: ruff-hooks
plugins.description: PostToolUse hook: autofix + format Python on every edit; surface remaining ruff diagnostics. No LSP — composes with ruff-lsp or pylsp.

plugins.name: ruff-lsp
plugins.description: Registers `ruff server` as the Python LSP. Mutually exclusive with the `pylsp` plugin.

plugins.name: pylsp
plugins.description: Registers python-lsp-server + pylsp-mypy as the Python LSP; mypy-on-edit fallback hook. Mutually exclusive with the `ruff-lsp` plugin.

plugins.name: shuck
plugins.description: Lint + auto-fix shell files on every edit; registers shuck server as LSP.
